newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Goodman Hardie to raise up to A$29.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: Goodman Hardie to raise up to A$29.9 mln.

text.p: Goodman Hardie Industrial Property Trust said on Monday it would raise up to A$29.9 million through the issue of up to 26 million new units at a price of A$1.15 per unit.

Goodman Hardie Property Trust manager, Goodman Hardie Management Australia Ltd, said the money would be used to fund the purchase of a Sydney property for A$14.6 million, to retire debt of up to A$14.6 million and to pay issue costs of A$700,000.
